reason: V5.519 locks the end-to-end release blocker INVITATION_TO_PRODUCT / HUMAN_ENTITLEMENT_GUARD_CROSSES_DESKTOP_RUNTIME_AND_REQUIRES_MISSING_MATRIX_OPENID_PER_REQUEST. Real local runtime evidence records MATRIX_OPENID_TOKEN_REQUIRED and WAITING_FOR_PRODUCT_ENTITLEMENT after the backend is already ready. Exact current source proves invitation login correctly hands accountAuth to Element onLoggedIn, Element already owns CompleteSecurity/E2E and maps HomePage to the Yance location, but two same-root authorization defects prevent a usable Product shell: DesktopHost steady-state Runtime API v2 is mounted behind the human Personal Access guard, and PersonalAccessService.authorizeProductRequest delegates to status(input) even though the guard supplies only method/path, so ordinary TESTER Product requests can never carry the Matrix OpenID required by status(). The predecessor workaround added WAITING_FOR_PRODUCT_ENTITLEMENT plus timer/backoff state inside RuntimeProjectionCoordinator; under current Mature Authority Preservation that is Shadow Authority and must be retired, not tuned. This authorization preserves Element/Matrix session and OpenID ownership, Unkey/keyId entitlement ownership, existing local API-session security, and the existing Product guard while removing the cross-owner boundary and proving one stored-key login-to-real-Product Golden Journey without consuming another invitation.
